summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with an updated docstring; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring np.float -> float; math import removed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. The pinned patch values in test_loading_array are taken from the spec and are unverified; the test may fail on them even if the code is correct. Line lengths in edited files are within 120 apart from pre-existing lines in other modules.
